description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - bag watch: at a station or cafe, the main line is waiting or buying and the side line is the bag at your feet or behind you - register the bag by looking toward it and holding steady, then a timer reminds you to look back every 5 minutes (DEMO interval); a look-back confirmed by tap or steady nod resets the timer, an unconfirmed reminder escalates; when you want to leave, the leave gate forces a look-back: turn to the registered heading, hold steady, and tap or nod GOT to attest you have it - ending without the gate only stops you on the spot and names the bag as unconfirmed, it never says you may go. No detection, no location, no step or movement sensing: the agent never knows whether the bag is really in hand. Session memory only, wiped on close.
name: bag-watch
